context_requirements: Expression of MGLL in the assayed cell line
Presence of an endocannabinoid/2-arachidonoylglycerol or monoacylglycerol lipid signaling tone that can be altered by MGLL inhibition
Cellular context in which MGLL-derived lipid mediators feed into transcriptional pathways
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h after 10 micromolar MGLL inhibitor treatment in any of the nine cell lines
A shared transcriptional signature across multiple cell lines that is absent in MGLL-knockout or MGLL-inactive controls
Enrichment of lipid-metabolism, endocannabinoid-signaling, or immediate-early gene programs specifically after MGLL inhibition
